display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-05-D2-08 Demonstration for Long-duration Battery Energy Storage Systems (BATT4EU Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-05-D2-08 Demonstration for Long-duration Battery Energy Storage Systems (BATT4EU Partnership)
executive_summary: Demonstrates non-commercial battery systems delivering more than eight hours of storage for utility-scale or industrial uses. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 18.8 million, with around EUR 9.4 million expected per project. Opening 2027-05-05, full proposal deadline 2027-09-15 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 105–107, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to Time-dependent transmission rights contract. Annex B permits a funded Dutch consortium member. The topic expressly allows front-of-meter grid-scale cases and asks projects to quantify system impact, creating a plausible grid-validation role subject to the China-control restriction. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
